content:
“You're a power saver!”

**Batteries Included** is an Intelligence-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

Batteries Included reduces the weight of all ammo used by energy weapons.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★★ | 2 | Energy weapon ammo weighs 90% less. | 003896E0 | 
| ★ | 1 | Energy weapon ammo weighs 45% less. | 003896DC | 

- Batteries Included can stack with the Belted Legendary mod
 - Energy ammo weight can be reduced by a maximum of 90%. If Batteries Included 2 is equipped, the Belted legendary effect will not decrease the weight any further.
- Batteries Included modifies the weight of the following ammunition:

- Before update 58, Batteries Included had 3 ranks that reduced energy ammo weight by 30%/60%/90%.

"Batteries Included" refers to electronic toys that come with prepacked batteries.

Other ammo weight reduction perks include:

- Bandolier - ballistic ammo
- Ordnance Express - explosive ammo
